name: web-mobile-app-builder
description: Design, build, improve and verify distinctive websites, web apps, PWAs, native Apple apps, Android apps and cross-platform mobile apps from ideas or existing projects.

interface.longDescription: Turn product ideas, designs, screenshots or existing repositories into well-crafted websites, full-stack apps, progressive web apps, native SwiftUI iOS/macOS applications, Android apps and cross-platform applications. Uses curated design references, explicit visual systems, platform-aware implementation, security and testing guidance, and independent code/visual review. Supports real subagents and coding tools only where the host provides them; does not itself include a hosted coding service or promise deployment, simulator access or live execution without tools.
capabilities: Build new websites and full-stack web apps
Build native iOS and macOS apps with SwiftUI
Build Android and cross-platform mobile apps
Plan user journeys and design systems
Verify responsive UI, accessibility and security
defaultPrompt: Build a polished full-stack web app from this idea with a clear visual direction, working flows and tests.
Build a native SwiftUI iOS app using Apple conventions, not a web-style interface.
Design and build a cross-platform mobile app with platform-aware navigation and reliable test evidence.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: Updated developer and author attribution to Tekris Labs, preserving existing skills, icons, starter prompts and product identity.
